title: Allocate aligned native memory with type lifetime
goal: Allocate aligned unmanaged state owned by a runtime type; use when loader lifetime is appropriate and keep the collectible owner alive through every native access.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins are verification baselines.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical declared language mode; no preview syntax switch.

packageAssets: System.Runtime reference and CoreLib/CoreCLR runtime; no package route.
prerequisites: Nullable/implicit-usings console project; internal canonical helper called from its assembly.
Real runtime Type; dynamic code for the collectible RunAndCollect fixture.
platforms: Windows x64 CoreCLR measured; other runtimes/platforms unverified.
providers: Runtime loader allocator; no external provider.
stabilityLimitations: Not marked experimental in the audited contract. Actual RC2 evidence, not final-GA verification; PIN-959/PIN-962 remain open.
constraints: Use a real runtime Type; keep it strongly reachable until all pointer/span/native users finish. Never manually free runtime-owned memory.
Repeated allocations persist until type unload; choose explicit allocation/free for deterministic early release.
Collectible fixture needs CoreCLR dynamic code. Windows x64 executed; no Native AOT/Mono/browser or memory-reclamation timing claim.
